title: WorkOS: Let Agents Use Your Tools Without Giving Them Free Rein
content_html:
WorkOS: Let Agents Use Your Tools Without Giving Them Free Rein

My thanks to WorkOS for sponsoring DF last week. An agent’s job isn’t known until it runs, so a role assigned in advance is always too much or too little. Give the agent a task instead, and every call it makes gets checked against that intent, whether it’s reading a Linear issue or emailing a distribution list.

With WorkOS Airlock, you set the policies once. Each call is allowed, denied, or sent to a human for approval, and every verdict is logged.

Request early access today.

★ Sunday, 15 November 2026
